info.headline: Veter - zmerna ogroženost (Stopnja 2/4) - Slovenija / severovzhod
info.description: Maksimalna hitrost vetra : od 50 do 70 km/h. Veter maje drevesa, lahko lomi manjše veje.
info.instruction: Vrata in okna naj bodo zaprta. Priporočamo dodatno previdnost v prometu predvsem v primeru bočnega vetra in na izpostavljenih mestih (npr. mostovi, useki). Ne zadržujte se na potencialno nevarnih mestih.

parameter.value: Maksimalna hitrost vetra : od 50 do 70 km/h.

info.senderName: Slovenian Environment Agency (ARSO vreme)
info.headline: Moderate Wind Warning (Degree 2/4) - Slovenia / North-East
info.description: Maximum wind speed : from 50 to 70 km/h. Wind sways trees and may break smaller branches.
info.instruction: Doors and windows should be kept closed. We recommend additional caution in traffic, especially in crosswinds and in exposed areas (e.g. bridges, cuttings). Do not linger in potentially dangerous areas.

parameter.value: Maximum wind speed : from 50 to 70 km/h.
